atoms.text: This is Tina the Tortoise. She is going to show you around some ports in the UK.

instruction.text: Answer Tina’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What is a port?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: A port is a place by the water where ships can load and unload cargo.
A port is a shell that tortoises can hide inside.

instruction.text: Select the three images of ports in the UK.

feedback.finish: Correct! Ports are always by the river or the sea. They have lots of space for large containers that get brought here and are waiting to get shipped.
feedback.wrong: These are some hills in England.

instruction.text: This is the Port of Liverpool in England. Select the containers to learn more.

feedback.end: This busy port plays a key role in handling trade between the UK and North America. Trade is all about buying and selling things, especially between different countries.

instruction.text: This is Belfast Harbour in Northern Ireland. Select the ship to learn more.

feedback.end: Belfast Harbour handles most of Northern Ireland’s sea trade. Along with all the cargo it ships, it also has many ferry services and cruise ships for travellers!

instruction.text: This is Cardiff Docks in Wales. Select the cranes to learn more.

text: Cranes are used in ports to pick up the heavy containers and put them onto the ships.
hint.label: Crane

feedback.end: This port used to ship huge amounts of coal to the rest of the world thanks to all the coal found nearby. Nowadays, it mostly ships big containers, steel and forest products.

feedback.finish: These are called cargo ships. They need to be really big so that they can carry lots of things to other places.

atoms.a: “What do ships that carry cargo around the world look like?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>What do ships that carry cargo around the world look like?</prosody></voice>

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Tina wants to learn more about the Port of Liverpool by talking with workers here. Listen to the options and select the questions she could ask.

atoms.a: “I want to learn more about what this port is used for. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>I want to learn more about what this port is used for. What should I ask?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: What kinds of products are often shipped from here?
What is your favourite kind of weather?

atoms.a: “I want to learn more about how busy this port is. What should I ask?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>I want to learn more about how busy this port is. What should I ask?</prosody></voice>

b.sound: How many ships come here every day?
Do you like the view of the sea from this port?
